parameters.content:
## STEP 1 · Intake & pre-screening
**👤 MSME** fills the BELTRAIDE EOI form → **📏 rules** check fields, district, sector, tier thresholds, program window → MSME submits formal application (DTP).

## STEP 2 · Screening & evaluation
**🤖 AI** extracts with citations · **📏 rules** compute eligibility + preliminary /80 · **👤 Panel** decides (never auto-reject).

## STEP 3 · Advisor review & DTP versions
Structured checks · revision loop with MSME · every version hashed · **approved version locked** as reference for steps 4, 8, 11.

## STEP 4 · EOI & DSP matchmaking
Hard filters → **30/30/10/10/20** weighted score → explainable shortlist → **👤 Staff** approve (reason if not #1).

## STEPS 5–7 · OUT OF SCOPE
Agreement, 1st disbursement, implementation. Payments are never executed by this system.

## STEP 8 · First report review
**🤖 AI** reads receipt, invoice, contract, evidence · **📏 validator** R8.01–R8.10 · **👤 Staff** accept → unlocks 2nd disbursement.

## STEPS 9–11 · Final report & close-out
2nd disbursement + final implementation out of scope · **📏 R11** validator · **👤 Staff** close the case · full case record + audit trail.

## 🤖 SHARED AI SERVICE (bounded)
Claude only **extracts values + exact quotes + page**. Every quote is verified against the source. If the AI fails or is unavailable → **deterministic fallback** so the case never stops. Temperature 0, pinned model, versioned prompts.

# DIBED supervised workflow
**Legend:** 👤 human decision · 📏 deterministic rule (rulebook 1.0.0-demo) · 🤖 AI extraction · 🛡️ guardrail · 🛟 fallback · ⏸️ out of scope

One execution = one MSME case. Open **Executions** to see the raw input/output of every box.
